summary: Per-container hard CPU quotas do not model a 2 vCPU VPS: tiny quotas on shared services (redis-cache 0.02 CPU, throttled 202 s in a 6-min smoke) starve every request. Emulate with one parent cgroup capping the whole stack at 2 cores / 2 GiB. Also, a smoke must deploy the candidate tree, not the harness worktree's base code.
